messages:
anya: Quick heads-up — opened a small docs PR to clarify batching + caching examples and to add an explicit quantization profile recommendation for Llama-style models. Need quick review before EOD so we can merge for the optimize toolkit release. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/492
sam: Nice. Can you include a short SDK snippet showing continuous batching + prefix caching? I'll drop a JS example here that we can copy into the PR.
sam: ```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood.Client({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY});
const res = await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood-llama-13b',
  input: 'Summarize the PR',
  streaming: true,
  batching: {maxBatchSize: 8, timeoutMs: 20},
  cache: {prefixCache: true, ttlMs: 300000},
  quantProfile: 'q4_k_m'
});
```
liam: For quant profile wording: recommend 'q4_k_m' for high-throughput inference on Ampere/Turing and note small quality drop vs fp16. Also add a reference to the eval set we ran (linked in the PR comments).
olivia: Thanks — can we add this under /docs/optimize/batching-and-cache.md and then add a short callout box with 'When to use quant profiles' and a link to /docs/optimize/quant-profiles.md? I can add the heading + toc update.
marco: Make sure the recommendation reads as 'recommended for throughput-first workloads' not 'always use'. We should avoid promising specific latency numbers.
anya: Good call. I'll update the language. @sam can you paste the JS snippet into the PR and add a Python equivalent? @liam can you add a one-line accuracy note and a link to the eval run (or paste the eval id)?
sam: Added JS snippet in a new commit. Python coming in 2 mins.
sam: ```py
from redwood import Client
import os

c = Client(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
resp = c.generate(
  model='redwood-llama-13b',
  input='TL;DR this PR',
  streaming=True,
  batching={'max_batch_size':8,'timeout_ms':20},
  cache={'prefix_cache':True,'ttl_ms':300000},
  quant_profile='q4_k_m'
)
print(resp.stream())
```
deploy-bot: Deploy preview created: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/optimize/492 — staging link up for QA :white_check_mark:
olivia: I'll review the deploy preview and tweak the wording for the callout box. If everything looks good I'll approve the docs PR.
liam: posted eval link in PR comment: https://internal-evals/redwood/ev-2026-07-18-77
anya: Great — plan: merge after olivia approves and marco signs off on the phrasing. target: EOD. Thanks team :sparkles:
